text_simplified: The prophets and the righteous—such as Ibrahim and Ya'qub (peace be upon them)—advised their children and guided them. Ibrahim and Ya'qub (peace be upon them) urged their sons to remain steadfast upon Islam. Allah praised Isma'il (peace be upon him) for commanding his family to pray and give zakah. Allah commanded His Prophet ﷺ to instruct his family to pray and to remain constant in it. Among the guidance for children is that the parent keeps them away from what corrupts their akhlaq and religion, such as songs, harmful channels, and places of forbidden amusement. The ninth foundation is to be mindful of their companions, for the companion draws one along.
